title: mail-server memory: PushSubscriptionBackend + EmailPushBackend, deliver_email, test-helpers, end-to-end tests
description:
Design: docs/design/emailpush.md. Decisions: docs/design/DECISIONS.md.
Note key: E10. Crates: jmap-mail-server. Size: L.

Spec: RFC 8620 §7.2 (PushSubscription, verification), draft-ietf-jmap-emailpush-05 §3 ("delivered" = conditions that change EmailDelivery, not JMAP creation), §4, §5. Design: docs/design/emailpush.md §7, §10 (r44n.3 memory, deliver); decisions 9, 10 and 16.

In crate-jmap-mail-server memory (new memory/push.rs, impl blocks in memory/mod.rs, Cargo.toml): MemoryBackend (CallerCtx = (), single owner) implements jmap_server::PushSubscriptionBackend with a CSPRNG verification code, an overQuota cap, PushVerification queued in an outbox Vec, create_push_subscription and update_push_subscription calling check_email_push_change before storing (there is no check_push_subscription_change hook, decision 16), and list_push_subscriptions stripping with prune_email_push. It implements EmailPushBackend: every account returns EmailPushAccount { mail: true, object_ids: true, email_history: false }. New feature test-helpers = ["memory"] with set_email_push_account_for_test (no-mail, no-ObjectID, Email-history, revoked) and set_push_max_bytes_for_test; the self dev-dependency gets features ["memory","mdn","sieve","emailpush","test-helpers"]. pub async fn deliver_email(account_id, raw, mailbox_ids, keywords) -> Result<(Id, Vec<(Id, OutboundEmailPush)>), _> reuses the import path, bumps Email state and a new EmailDelivery state, and runs email_pushes_for per stored subscription with max_bytes = PUSH_PLAINTEXT_BYTES (3993, documented as equal to jmap_web_push::MAX_PLAINTEXT). It returns the outbox and does no network I/O. Email/import does not call it.
Acceptance: the §5 request/delivery end to end via the dispatcher (register_push_subscription_handlers + mail handlers) yields the spec's EmailPush figure; normalized emailPush returned by /get and echoed in created/updated (decision 9); objectHistory with email_history set via test helper is stored without it, and rejected with the default (decision 10); deliver_email pushes while Email/import and Email/set create do not; r44n.3 end to end after revoking R — /get lacks R, an update of types only succeeds and the stored map loses R, patch emailPush/R => ["emailPush","emailPush/R"], patch emailPush/R/urgency => invalidPatch, deliveries to R push nothing; splitting exercised through set_push_max_bytes_for_test. Public-api snapshot and CHANGELOG.
